title: Upper bound on compact sets from sub-subsequence comparisons on thickenings (parent step 2(b); Simon 7.2.4 (12)–(13))
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ and μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be Borel measures on ℝ^P (Measure (Euclid P)). Assume (a) μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; and (b′) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, every ε > 0 and every strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ there are a set W ⊆ ℝ^P with K ⊆ W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) = {x : infEdist(x, K) < ε} and a strictly increasing φ′ : ℕ → ℕ with limsup_{i→∞} μ_{ψ(φ′(i))}(W) ≤ μ(W). Then limsup_{j→∞} μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P (lim sup in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ limsup (fun i => μs (ψ (φ' i)) W) atTop ≤ μ W) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K
